G001 DRAWING INDEX
G002 ACCESSIBILITY STANDARDS

1. THE GENERAL CONTRACTOR SHALL COMPLY WITH ALL APPLICABLE LOCAL STATE AND
FEDERAL CODES AND REGULATIONS PERTAINING TO SAFETY OF PERSONS, PROPERTY AND
ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION.
2. THE GENERAL CONTRACTOR SHALL PROVIDE AND MAINTAIN BARRICADES, LIGHTING,
ETC AS APPLICABLE BY CODES AND REGULATIONS TO PROTECT PEDESTRIANS AND
WORKERS.
3. THE GENERAL CONTRACTOR SHALL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR ALL PERMIT FEES AND
APPLICATIONS
4. THE GENERAL CONTRACTOR SHALL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR FIELD CHECKING AND
VERIFYING ANY AND ALL DIMENSIONS AND OR EXISTING FIELD CONDITIONS PRIOR
TO START.
5. THE GENERAL CONTRACTOR SHALL REPORT ANY AND ALL DISCREPANCIES AND
OMISSIONS TO THE ARCHITECT PRIOR RO INSTALLATION OF NEW WORK.
6. THE GENERAL CONTRACTOR SHALL REPORT ANY AND ALL DISCREPANCIES WITH
ARCHITECT PRIOR TO BIDDING.
